summary: Every matchable effect now shows its level 2, its form when the card sits on the mark it matched, and every question was re-read for uniqueness and fun, with a pair reviewer reading each family again. 1,527 live questions, 270 retired in place (187 this round: duplicates, twins where one effect's level 2 was another's level 1, and premises the game does not have). 196 had options rewritten; 210 carry a one-line flag saying why the effect may not earn a slot; 130 skills, stamps and ranks say their level 2 is only the flat bonus a match pays. Family AB is 19 new effects built around aiming at marks. Family AC (98 questions) asks the level 2 of each effect you had already ruled on, so no recorded answer changed meaning; its (d) keeps the effect with no level 2. One question is not in the list: is fame spendable? About fifteen options spend it. Q0011 and Q0047 are still the only answered questions that are retired.
